gaps.detail: Stack too deep (31) in BlockVerifier.sol:7 assembly during per-file solc 0.8.7 compile; known solc 0.8.x issue; extractor per-file fallback supports no optimizer/via-ir workaround.
gaps.rationale: UniswapV2CSSR/SushiswapV2CSSR are oracle price-source observers (saveState/saveReserve record block-proof data on-chain) consumed read-only by MochiCSSRv0 via getLiquidity; no role/auth Access Control logic.
